stem.alt: Displayed structural formula of a triglyceride with three fatty acid chains attached to a glycerol backbone

stem.text: What will be the products after hydrolysis of this triglyceride?

A.text: 1 molecule of glycogen, 3 unsaturated fatty acids and 3 molecules of water

B.text: 1 molecule of glycerol, 2 saturated fatty acids and 1 unsaturated fatty acid

C.text: 1 molecule of glycogen, 2 saturated fatty acids and 1 unsaturated fatty acid

D.text: 1 molecule of glycerol, 1 saturated fatty acid, 2 unsaturated fatty acids and 3 molecules of water
